stem: An urban planning study measures the commute time (minutes) for a sample of 20 city workers. The sample mean is 18.2 min with a sample standard deviation of 4.0 min. Assuming the data are approximately normally distributed, estimate the true population mean and provide a 95% confidence interval.

ground_truth.answer: Population mean ≈ 18.2 min. 95% CI = [16.3, 20.1]. Point estimate: 18.2 min.

common_failure_modes: Using z-critical value instead of t-critical for small samples
Not reporting the confidence interval alongside the point estimate
